g.title: Makes three contributions
g.text: This paper makes three, in sequence.

g.title: First proposes DARTFormer
g.desc: first proposes dartformer differentiable-architecture-search-style method efficiently finds best attention task
g.text: Differentiable architecture search that efficiently finds
the best attention for a task.

g.title: Second extends to heterogeneous Transformers
g.desc: second extends framework build search heterogeneous transformers combine multiple attention
g.text: Build & search multi-attention models that combine several
attention types — via NAS Prune (expensive iterative pruning)

g.title: Third empirically shows they cannot outperform
g.desc: third most importantly shows empirically these heterogeneous transformers cannot outperform
g.text: Empirically, these heterogeneous Transformers CANNOT beat
the best homogeneous Transformer on the long-range NLP
